name: 1pcs Beauty Glazed Lively Waterproof & Long Lasting Lip Liner - 9 Shades Available
description:
1pcs Beauty Glazed Lively Waterproof & Long Lasting Lip Liner - 10 Shades Available 
A kiss proof lipliner that lines, defines and shapes lips with creamy matte color. 
24-Hour Wear: This lip liner offers long-lasting performance, staying vibrant and defined for an entire day. 
Waterproof Formula: Resists smudging and fading, even in challenging conditions, making it perfect for all-day wear. 
Precision Application: Achieve well-defined and perfectly shaped lips with its precise, easy-to-use design. 
Versatile Shades: Choose from a range of beautiful shades to complement your lipstick or wear it on its own. 
Prevents Feathering: Helps prevent lipstick from feathering or bleeding, ensuring a clean and polished look. 
Smooth and Creamy: The formula glides on smoothly, making it comfortable to apply and blend. 
Enhances Lip Contours: Create the illusion of fuller, well-defined lips for a more striking appearance. 
Suitable for All Occasions: Ideal for daily wear, special events, or a night out, adding the finishing touch to your makeup. 
Lip-Friendly Ingredients: Formulated with care for your lips, it's gentle and suitable for various skin types. 
Easy to Carry: The compact and portable design allows for on-the-go touch-ups and travel convenience.
